title: After the Tenno Sho (Autumn): Follow Your Heart

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: To an Umamusume, the Twinkle Series is synonymous with dreams.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hair-raising clashes, passion that permeates one's whole body, frenzied stampedes down the stretch.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Countless hopefuls reach for the throne, for honor, glory, and the realization of dreams they've harbored since childhood.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And their dreams become the dreams of all who watch from the stands.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Some are enchanted by the Cinderella story of a runner emerging from humble rural origins out into the national spotlight.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Some see their hopes and ideals embodied in the prideful scions of a prestigious family.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And some…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Pant… Pant…

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Ineeeees! Big Siiis!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: …Haha!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Some see her running in the rain, a wide grin across her face even as sweat drips from her brow, and can't help but share her smile, and her dreams.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: More than anyone, you just want me to have a good time racing. Can I count on you to always push me to have fun?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, knew it.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Still, I'm not going to run for you, y'know. I run for myself!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I won't let anyone's cheers be a burden. I'll let them be my strength instead, and then use that strength to zoom across the finish line!
choice_data_list: If that's what works for you, it works for me!
If that's what works for you, it works for me!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I thought you'd say that!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: So, what should our next goal be?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: The Japan Cup? Or maybe we could aim for the Arima Kinen?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Y'know, I heard Oguri and Ryan are both gonna be running in this year's Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: But no matter who I'm up against, and no matter how tough the race gets…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I know that I'm gonna enjoy it more than anyone else!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I think hard about which of the two races she mentioned to set as our goal. The answer I come to is…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: …I see. So we're gonna take on the world, huh? Hehe! This should be interesting!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And with that, Ines Fujin and I begin our preparations for the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: That's what I thought you'd say! And that's what I wanna do, too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Goal Race is now the Arima Kinen.
And with that, Ines Fujin and I begin our preparations for the Arima Kinen.
